questions.q: What was Onan's sin, according to the class?
choices: Refusing to raise up seed to his brother
questions.explain: Do not build a doctrine on the wrong point; the brother's duty later became law (Deuteronomy 25:5-9).

questions.q: Why did Judah think Tamar was a harlot?
questions.explain: A harlot was known by her dress (Proverbs 7:10).

questions.q: What did Judah say when Tamar produced his signet, bracelets and staff?
choices: She hath been more righteous than I
questions.explain: Because that I gave her not to Shelah my son.
The midwife bound a scarlet thread on Zarah's hand, but his brother broke forth first.
